QuestInfo.name: Jenn's Dangerous Adventure
QuestInfo.0: El Nath resident #bJenn#k is trembling in fear in the #bLion King's Castle #m211060200##k. Talk to Jenn.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161003# says he was roaming around El Nath in search of his missing brother, and somehow ended up at the castle of the Red Lion King. He's desperate for help taking down the monsters, so he can rescue his brother.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161003# says he was roaming around El Nath in search of his missing brother, and somehow ended up at the castle of the Red Lion King. He's desperate for help taking down the monsters, so he can rescue his brother.

0.0: Help! Is there anyone out there? If you can hear me, please help! I'm trapped in El Nath! I came here to find my younger brother, but now I'm surrounded by monsters! Are there any strong adventurers out there willing to help?

yes.0: Wow, someone can hear me! Please, get here as fast as you can. I think I'm in #bthe first tower of the weird castle at El Nath#k! There are bunch of super strong monsters here! Help!
yes.1: Please, bring help with you! The monsters here have incredibly high HP! I doubt you can handle them yourself! Wait, no, that sounded bad...I just mean thaaaaAAAAAAAAHHHH!! NO! HELP ME!!

no.0: Ahhh, where are all the strong adventurers of Maple World when I need them?

1.0: Ohhh, thank you, thank you! You are my sav--huh? You're younger than I expected. With less muscles. And no beard. Agh, nevermind the formalities. Have I got a story for you!

yes.0: My name is #p2161003#. I'm a craftsman, and I was born in El Nath. I was working in Ludibrium for a while to save up money and then returned to El Nath. But I returned to discover my brother was missing.
yes.1: I asked around everywhere, but no one knew my brother's whereabouts. I thought he ran away from home, but he's never been the brave sort. I decided to look for him myself... I figured he got stuck in a snowdrift or something.
yes.2: But I couldn't find him anywhere! Eventually, I ended up here. No one comes here...I remember this area used to be blocked, so I thought it was strange that it was open. And guess what I found? My brother was held captive here!
yes.3: I couldn't just leave him, but a weak guy like me couldn't save him, either. That's why I needed a strong adventurer. And I finally found one... sniff sniff... My hero.
yes.4: I bet you're wondering how I got here if I'm so weak, huh? Well, I used the ultimate weak-guy technique: Play Dead. Yep, I'm a master at it. Sometimes I fall asleep while doing it and get frostbite. I'm that good.
